name: Menu
notes: The menu is a map of 7 x 7 screens (1680 x 1120 px) the current monster walks (plr_menu): the camera shows one whole screen at a time and jumps to the next one, in one frame, when the monster's middle crosses an edge (camera mode 'screens'). Screens are named like a chessboard, columns A-G and rows 1-7. The middle one, D4, is the Green Meadow, as before: the mountain wall with the cave along the top (walking in opens the monster picker), the garden at the top left (4 plots: one growth step per finished run, 5 from seed to item), the CLASSIC, CLEAR SAVE and WAVES signs along the bottom (the WAVES sign stands greyed out until all 9 monsters are freed, then opens the waves mode), and the gold line at the bottom. The Meadow has three openings: west to the Boulder Canyon, east to the Ember Crater (past a wall of flames), south to the Verdant Jungle (past a bramble wall). Around it lie 8 lands of 6 screens each, one per run world: Boulder Canyon (A4-C5), Verdant Jungle (D5-E7), Ember Crater (E3-G4), Coral Lagoon (C1-D3), Storm Plateau (A1-B3), Miasma Swamp (E1-G2), Sky Isle (F5-G7) and Haunted Hollow (A6-C7). Each land's monster is trapped on its challenge screen, guarded by monsters or past an obstacle only the monster freed just before can get past, so only one new land is ever open: the Canyon's path is open (4 Pebbulks guard Emberpup), fire burns the Jungle's bramble (Splashell caught in vines), water puts out the Crater's flames (8 Emberpups guard Voltail), electricity shatters the crystal on the way to the Lagoon (5 Splashells on islands guard Sproutle), a grass move grows a vine bridge over the ravine into the Plateau (4 Voltails on mesas guard Venomole), poison melts the boulder on the way to the Swamp (4 armored Sproutles guard Gustling), only a flyer crosses the hole into the Sky Isle (Wispook on a pillar), and only a ghost passes the haunted hedge into the Hollow (3 Furrbits and 3 Venomoles in a hedge maze guard Pebbulk). Outside the Meadow the monster fights with its 3 moves on A, B and R (map HUD: charge circles, LV7, HP); it can faint and then wakes up in the Meadow. Each screen's things appear when it shows and go when it doesn't (a challenge left early starts over); wild monsters never leave their screen. When the scene opens it loads the saved progress (an old save gets the ways its unlocked monsters had already opened), grows the garden after a finished run, and shows the Meadow. on_screen, on every screen change: resets this screen's kills and hints, works out the land (its name shows for 3 s on walking into another land), switches between the Meadow's HUD (moves off, HP refilled) and the map HUD (moves on), and plays the run song on a challenge screen whose monster is still trapped (with the garden items its fight is tuned for, for 3 s), the menu song everywhere else.
